items.title: Deal with US not imminent, Iran says
items.description: The US secretary of state earlier said that an agreement could possibly come on Monday.

items.title: Oil prices slide on hopes of US-Iran peace deal
items.description: Trump said on Saturday that an agreement would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, without giving further details.

items.title: White House gunman had previous run-ins with Secret Service, court documents show
items.description: The suspect previously obstructed a White House entry lane in June of 2025 and told Secret Service agents he was Jesus Christ.

items.title: Three killed in Uganda after crashing into elephant
items.description: Four people were also injured in the incident inside Murchison Falls National Park, officials say.

items.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
items.description: A hypersonic missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.

items.title: 'Blistering heat': Indians warned to stay indoors as temperatures soar
items.description: The BBC's Sumedha Pal described how difficult it was to be standing in the streets of Delhi as temperatures rose to 45C .

items.title: At least 19 people taken to hospital after 'strong smell' reported at Tokyo mall
items.description: Police say a man sprayed a substance at an ATM in the luxury Ginza 6 shopping centre.

items.title: Anger grows after China's deadliest coal mining disaster in years
items.description: On China's tightly-controlled internet, people are calling for justice and questioning how this happened.

items.title: Clashes as Venezuelan prisoners protest over alleged mistreatment
items.description: The prisoners insisted their protest was peaceful but that security forces deployed to quell it opened fire.

items.title: Turkish riot police storm opposition offices after leaders ousted
items.description: Officers forced their way into the building days after the party vowed to defy a court ruling removing its leaders.

items.title: Senegal's leadership row mounts as parliament speaker resigns
items.description: Some speculate that El Malick Ndiaye stepped down so that ousted-PM Ousmane Sonko can take his place.

items.title: First Hong Kong astronaut launches into space onboard Chinese mission
items.description: The 43-year-old police officer and mother of three serves as the team's payload scientist.
